Marion County is horse country — the thoroughbred farms around Ocala sit alongside one of Florida's largest logistics build-outs, drawn by the I-75 corridor and cheap land. Affordability plus the sprawling Marion Oaks and On Top of the World communities have made it a major destination for both distribution tenants and relocating retirees.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 21, 2026
